title: US charges Iranian hackers over $3.4 billion intellectual property theft
summary: Using access to these accounts, the hackers reportedly stole 31.5 terabytes of academic data, including journals, theses, dissertations, ebooks, and research across numerous disciplines, valued at approximately $3.4 billion. All defendants are presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
